what: The vaults this site uses. Only the PUBLIC vault's READ key is here, by design; its write key and the private vault's key are held by Dinis and exist nowhere in this repository. validate.js refuses any string carrying sgit's private-key prefix anywhere in the tree.

layout.README.md: what the vault is, the rule, and how to work in it
layout._page.json: the vault's own front page, rendered by the vault browser
layout.book/: the working copy of the book: v1/content/ and v1/images/ as imported, the text the second edition starts from
layout.map/map.json: the chapter-to-article map, copied from the repository at each release
layout.reviews/: one record per chapter of the 2018 text (spelling, dated facts, broken links, verdict), the reviewer's work in progress
layout.interviews/: the editor's interview scripts and the transcripts, verbatim
layout.board/: BOARD.md and issues/open|blocked|done/: what is open, in progress and done
layout.team/: the roles' working copies of their role.md, briefs and debriefs
layout.graph/: the book as a graph, when it exists: ontology, taxonomy, nodes per chapter, section and paragraph
layout.comments/: comments and voice comments attached to a section, as files

private.name: gen-z-developers-private
private.holds: the OpenRouter key with a credit limit, when Dinis puts it in; until then a README and openrouter.env.example
